Helper function: optimize the ordering of items for profile plots

Source: R/labels.R
optimize_order.Rd

Determines an ordering of the item factor levels so that grouped line charts (e.g. cluster profile plots) read clearly, with as little line "jumping" / crossing as possible. The returned vector can be passed to .plot_lines() (or used directly to relevel the item factor).

Usage

optimize_order(data, method = TRUE)

Arguments

data

A dataframe with the columns item, value, and .cross.

method

The ordering method. Either TRUE to automatically select a method ("olo" if seriation is installed, otherwise "min"), or one of the character values "max", "min", "spread", "gw", or "olo". Defaults to TRUE.

Value

A vector of item values in the optimized order.

Details

The following methods are supported:

TRUE

Automatically select a method (default). Uses "olo" if the seriation package is available, otherwise falls back to "min".

"max"

Order items by descending grand mean of value (default). Produces a monotonic ladder.

"min"

Order items by ascending grand mean of value.

"spread"

Order items by the range (max - min) of value across groups. Highlights the items that discriminate the groups most.

"gw", "olo"

Use seriation to minimise crossings across all groups simultaneously. "gw" = Gruvaeus–Wainer, "olo" = optimal leaf ordering. Requires the seriation package.
